name: Positive Two-Square Switch of Order 70
definition: Extract a 68-concept base from the certified 71-concept family with root $a=29$, missing corners $c=157,z=25$, and acquired square-support masks $6$ and $130$. Add $z,a$ or $c,a$ in the two opposite square orders.
parameters: Both resulting switch sides have 70 concepts and peel to 29. The verification stores 20 successful endpoint orders, including two fixed-edge tests.
properties: The two sides have the same shattered complex and the same positive endpoint behavior, showing that the geometric switch data alone do not force an endpoint change.
